p = [0] * 17
for i in range(1, 17):
    p[i] = p[i-1] * 10 + 1

def solve(n, length):
    q = n // p[length]
    r = n % p[length]
    if r == 0:
        return q * length
    else:
        a = solve(r, length - 1)
        b = length + solve(p[length] - r, length - 1)
        return q * length + min(a, b)

n = int(input().strip())
print(solve(n, 16))
